source.method: Figma MCP get_design_context + read-only Plugin API geometry, visibility bindings, exact icon sources and variable aliases

observations.note: 12 actual variants: both sizes have enabled/focused/typing/disabled with filtered=false; filtered=true has enabled/focused only. No measured filtered typing/disabled, dark, readonly or invalid visuals.

filter Boolean defaults false and controls visibility on 8 unfiltered action/filter frames. The 4 filtered=true frames are visibly present and not bound to this Boolean. Descendant visible=true alone does not mean effectively visible under a hidden action.
Clear and action/filter wrappers are local FRAMEs, not standalone AgentHubIconButton/AttachIconButton instances. Only their search/x/filter glyphs are component instances.

Root is SPACE_BETWEEN with sampled itemSpacing189; width1064/506, text content width and saved hidden trailing frame widths are sample data. Use a fluid input area and actual visible actions; preserve leading offsets across focus.
Focused/typing rectangles simulate a text caret. Use the native input caret rather than a second decorative caret or adding its sample 4px gap to placeholder padding.
